label: Trailer Cinematográfico (30s) · Velocidade Noturna (Ação & Corrida Clandestina)
description: Trailer de alta adrenalina e corrida de rua em 16:9: muscle cars e supercarros modificados acelerando na madrugada, labaredas saindo de escapamentos duplos, pneus cantando em asfalto sob luz de túnel e câmeras de perseguição ultra-rápidas.
resources: sound design de motor V8, turbo flutter e pneus

scenes.prompt: High-octane action thriller trailer cinematography in 16:9. A line of heavily customized matte black and raw carbon fiber hypercars revving at a deserted industrial container port at 3 AM. Red LED taillights reflect sharply on damp tarmac. 35mm anamorphic cinema lens, aggressive low camera angle. Non-verbal sound design: deafening twin-turbo V8 engine revs and aggressive turbo flutter. No speech or dialogue. On-screen text: A CIDADE É A PISTA.

High-octane action thriller trailer cinematography in 16:9. Extreme macro shot of a driver's gloved hand slamming a sequential manual shifter into gear as a glowing nitrous purge valve erupts with white pressurized steam from the hood. Non-verbal sound design: pneumatic nitrogen purge hiss, crisp mechanical gear clunk. No speech or dialogue. On-screen text: SEM FREIO.

High-octane action thriller trailer cinematography in 16:9. Ultra-fast tracking shot: cars launching side-by-side with tires smoking and spinning, throwing rooster tails of sparks from titanium underbody skids. Fast kinetic camera push. Non-verbal sound design: screaming tire burnout screech and thunderous acceleration roar. No speech or dialogue. On-screen text: 300 KM/H.

High-octane action thriller trailer cinematography in 16:9. High-speed drift through an illuminated neon highway tunnel. Yellow overhead lights create a hypnotic strobing streak across the glossy paint as two cars trade paint with flying metal sparks. Non-verbal sound design: screeching rubber grip, heavy metal scrape, massive sub-bass riser. No speech or dialogue. On-screen text: CADA SEGUNDO É TUDO.

High-octane action thriller trailer cinematography in 16:9. A police blockade explodes into chaos as a lead car weaves between cruisers, cutting through a highway toll plaza in slow motion with blue and red emergency strobes illuminating the night. Non-verbal sound design: shattering plastic barricades, police sirens cutting abruptly to heavy bass drop. No speech or dialogue. On-screen text: NENHUMA REGRA.

High-octane action thriller trailer cinematography in 16:9. Hero title reveal: brushed chrome and scorched titanium 3D typography engulfed in roaring blue exhaust flames against burning asphalt. Non-verbal sound design: massive engine backfire explosion resolving into raw silence. No speech or dialogue. On-screen text: VELOCIDADE NOTURNA.

narration.text: Alguns correm para vencer. Nós corremos porque a trezentos por hora, nada mais no mundo tem poder sobre você.
narration.voice: voz masculina brasileira jovem, rouca, adrenalítica, confiante e veloz, estilo filme de ação e perseguição veicular

blocks.text: Quando a noite cai, a cidade muda de dono.
Sem limites de velocidade. Sem margem para erro.
Aceleração máxima desde o primeiro segundo.
O asfalto cobra o preço de quem hesita.
Ultrapasse tudo o que tentar parar você.
